comment: The data behind map.html. One node per guide page in guides/, from each guide's opening table. A figure names the vendor page and the date the guide read it. tests/site.test.mjs checks every guide has a node and every path exists.

kinds.label: Agent link: ACP or GitHub Action

nodes.name: Ollama
nodes.tagline: Open-weight cloud models, paid per token from usage credits.
nodes.free: Pay as you go costs $0 a month and includes no cloud usage. Each request spends usage credits; Pro includes $60 of them a month (Ollama Pricing, read 2026-11-20).
nodes.signin: One account per person, signed in at ollama.com.
nodes.key: `ollama signin` for the app and CLI. `OLLAMA_API_KEY` for direct API calls.

claude.how: Ollama's Anthropic-compatible API: `ollama launch claude`, or base URL `https://ollama.com`. No hosted MCP server.

nodes.name: OpenRouter
nodes.tagline: One OpenAI-compatible API over many vendors, with free variants.
nodes.free: Model IDs ending in `:free` get 20 requests a minute and 50 a day. Buying 10 credits raises the daily cap to 1000 (OpenRouter Limits, read 2026-11-12).
nodes.signin: Anyone with an email. Credits are bought by card or crypto.
nodes.key: OAuth through the MCP server or `/connect`; else `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`.

claude.how: Hosted MCP server `https://mcp.openrouter.ai/mcp`, with an OAuth sign-in.

nodes.name: Groq
nodes.tagline: Fast hosted open-weight models on a free plan.
nodes.free: Free plan, per model: 30 requests a minute, 1K a day and 200K tokens a day (Groq Rate Limits, read 2026-11-12).
nodes.signin: A GroqCloud console sign-in. A payment method is asked for only on upgrade to Developer.
nodes.key: `GROQ_API_KEY`, from a key made in the console.

nodes.name: Hugging Face
nodes.tagline: Hub models, ZeroGPU Spaces, Inference Providers and an MCP server.
nodes.free: ZeroGPU gives a free account 5 minutes a day. Inference Providers has no monthly credit for free users (Hugging Face ZeroGPU docs, read 2026-11-12).
nodes.signin: Anyone with an email address.
nodes.key: `hf auth login` in the browser. Tools that need a token read `HF_TOKEN`.

claude.how: Hosted MCP server `https://huggingface.co/mcp`, with a browser sign-in.

nodes.name: NVIDIA
nodes.tagline: Trial NIM endpoints, NGC containers and a CUDA docs MCP server.
nodes.free: build.nvidia.com offers free inference for testing, not production. No credit amount or rate limit is published (NVIDIA API Trial Terms, read 2026-11-12).
nodes.signin: Anyone with an email address. An API key makes you a member of the NVIDIA Developer Program.
nodes.key: `NVIDIA_API_KEY` for the API catalog. `ngc config set` for NGC.

claude.how: The CUDA docs MCP server, with an NVIDIA Developer sign-in. The API catalog has none.

nodes.name: Together AI
nodes.tagline: Prepaid, pay-per-token open-weight models.
nodes.free: None. Together AI offers no free trial, and the first purchase is at least $15 (Together Billing and credits, read 2026-11-12).
nodes.signin: A Google or GitHub account. Together signs in only through OAuth.
nodes.key: `TOGETHER_API_KEY`. Together Link stores it with `togetherlink configure`.

nodes.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
nodes.tagline: Open-weight models on Cloudflare's network, with hosted MCP servers.
nodes.free: 10,000 Neurons a day at no charge, on Workers Free and Workers Paid (Cloudflare Workers AI pricing, read 2026-11-12).
nodes.signin: A Cloudflare account on the Workers Free plan.
nodes.key: `wrangler login` (browser OAuth). The REST API takes a Workers AI API token.

nodes.name: Claude API
nodes.tagline: Plan API credits, and keyless CI through workload identity federation.
nodes.free: Max gets $100 a month of API credits and Ultra $200. They do not cover Claude Code (Anthropic API credits page, read 2026-11-23).
nodes.signin: A Claude Console organization at platform.claude.com.
nodes.key: CI uses federation and no key. Otherwise one service account key per consumer in `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.

claude.how: The `anthropics/claude-code-action` GitHub Action takes the federation inputs.

nodes.name: Local models
nodes.tagline: MLX or LM Studio serving a model on your own port.
nodes.free: No account and no bill. A Mac with Apple silicon serves the model on your own hardware.
nodes.signin: None.
nodes.key: None. Both servers bind localhost by default, and you pass an explicit port.

opencode.how: MLX: a custom OpenAI-compatible provider on `http://127.0.0.1:3101/v1`. LM Studio: the built-in `lmstudio` provider.

claude.how: LM Studio only: `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3102`. MLX has no Anthropic route.

nodes.name: Modal
nodes.tagline: Serverless GPUs for your code, and per-token Shared Endpoints.
nodes.free: Starter gives $30 a month of free compute credits. Shared Endpoint tokens are not covered (Modal Plan pricing, read 2026-11-12).
nodes.signin: A browser sign-in. Whether Starter needs a card is not published.
nodes.key: `modal setup` (browser login). Shared Endpoints take a proxy token in `MODAL_PROXY_TOKEN`.
nodes.note: Modal documents hosting your own MCP server, not one of its own.

nodes.name: RunPod
nodes.tagline: Prepaid GPU pods and Serverless endpoints by the second.
nodes.free: Not published. Billing is prepaid credit, charged per second (RunPod Billing, read 2026-11-12).
nodes.signin: A verified email. A pod needs a payment method and purchased credits first.
nodes.key: MCP: OAuth through Sign in with Runpod. CLI: `runpodctl doctor`; else `RUNPOD_API_KEY`.

opencode.how: Not a built-in provider. A Serverless vLLM endpoint is OpenAI-compatible at `https://api.runpod.ai/v2/<ENDPOINT_ID>/openai/v1`.

claude.how: Hosted MCP server `https://mcp.runpod.io/`, with an OAuth sign-in.

nodes.name: AMD
nodes.tagline: ROCm, and one-time Developer Cloud credit on Instinct MI300X.
nodes.free: A $100 credit that expires 30 days from deposit. ROCm itself is open source (AMD Developer Cloud page, read 2026-11-12).
nodes.signin: An AMD AI Developer Program member, which is free to join. AMD awards the credit on your stated use case.
nodes.key: A browser sign-in to the AMD Developer Cloud console. ROCm needs no key.

opencode.how: A model you serve on the droplet with an OpenAI-compatible server is a custom provider.

nodes.name: Google Cloud
nodes.tagline: A trial credit for CPUs and storage, with exclusions.
nodes.free: Free Trial: a $300 credit valid for 90 days, and no billing unless you upgrade (Google Free cloud features, read 2026-11-23).
nodes.signin: A Google account. Sign-up needs a payment method valid for the trial.
nodes.key: `gcloud auth login`, a browser sign-in. Keep service account keys out of CI.
nodes.note: The credit pays for no connector. It cannot pay for Gemini on Vertex AI or for partner models offered as a managed API.

nodes.name: ComfyUI
nodes.tagline: Open-weight image and video workflows on Comfy Cloud or your own GPU.
nodes.free: Free: 5 free runs on real GPUs and free Comfy Agent credits for new users (Comfy Cloud pricing, read 2026-11-12).
nodes.signin: A Comfy account for Comfy Cloud. Self-hosted ComfyUI needs none.
nodes.key: `comfy cloud login` (browser OAuth). The MCP server uses OAuth through `/mcp`.

opencode.how: Add the Comfy Cloud MCP server with `opencode mcp add`.

claude.how: Comfy Cloud MCP server `https://cloud.comfy.org/mcp`. A local `comfy-mcp` drives your own box.

nodes.name: Training
nodes.tagline: LoRA, then reinforcement learning, on free and subscription credits.
nodes.free: Free lanes only. A lane counts as free when it stops at its limit or never takes a card.
nodes.signin: One per lane. The guide lists them.
nodes.key: One per lane, kept as in that lane's own guide.
nodes.note: A method, not a connector: it runs on the GPU lanes above.

nodes.name: GitHub
nodes.tagline: Free CI on Actions, a hosted MCP server and Copilot models.
nodes.free: Standard runners are free in public repositories. Free plans include $12 of compute a month (GitHub Actions billing, read 2026-11-12).
nodes.signin: Anyone with an email, on the GitHub Free plan.
nodes.key: `gh auth login` (browser OAuth). The token stays in the system credential store.

opencode.how: Provider `github-copilot`, through `/connect` and Login with GitHub Copilot.

nodes.name: Meshy
nodes.tagline: A picture or prompt to a textured, rigged, animated 3D model.
nodes.free: Free: 100 credits a month. Tasks from Claude Code need Pro, $20 a month for 1,000 credits (Meshy Pricing, read 2026-11-24).
nodes.signin: Email or Google sign-in. Free needs no credit card.
nodes.key: `meshy auth login --device` keeps the key off the machine. The MCP server reads `MESHY_API_KEY`.

opencode.how: The local `@meshy-ai/meshy-mcp-server` runs in any stdio MCP client.

claude.how: The `meshy-3d-generation` plugin, or the local `@meshy-ai/meshy-mcp-server`. Meshy's hosted server admits only ChatGPT today.

nodes.name: Goose
nodes.tagline: An open-source coding agent, CLI and desktop app.
nodes.free: Goose costs nothing. Models bill through the provider you pick (aaif-goose/goose, read 2026-11-20).
nodes.signin: None. Each model provider has its own account.
nodes.key: `goose configure` stores a provider key in the system keyring.

claude.how: The `claude-acp` provider runs Claude Code through ACP, with an active Claude Code subscription.

nodes.note: Goose and OpenCode are peer agents. Both run in Zed.

nodes.name: Zed
nodes.tagline: An editor on your own provider keys, with coding agents over ACP.
nodes.free: Zed Free is $0 forever, with unlimited use of your own API keys or external agents (Zed Pricing, read 2026-11-20).
nodes.signin: None for the editor. A Zed sign-in is only for Zed-hosted models.
nodes.key: Keys saved in the editor's LLM Providers settings go to the system keychain.

opencode.how: From the ACP Registry, or a custom agent that runs `opencode acp`.

claude.how: Claude Agent from the ACP Registry. It owns its login and billing.

nodes.name: Claude Desktop MCP
nodes.tagline: One MCP server for the Code tab and Cowork.
nodes.free: It adds no cost of its own. It picks the route that reaches both places.
nodes.signin: A Claude account. On Team and Enterprise an Owner adds the connector for the organization.
nodes.key: Per server. A server on a public HTTPS URL becomes a custom connector.

claude.how: A custom connector for a public HTTPS server, or a desktop extension for one that listens only on 127.0.0.1.

nodes.name: Logins
nodes.tagline: One sign-in order for every vendor.
nodes.free: It adds no cost. The logins catalog holds vendor facts, never an account or a secret.
nodes.signin: One order for every vendor in these guides.
nodes.key: Each passkey and code sits in a known place, in Apple Passwords.
nodes.note: A sign-in method, not a connector.
